english.title: Loading / unloading in loading control area on Christmas Day
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a large shop located in a loading control area,

(A)_[loaded]_
(B)_[unloaded]_

goods from a vehicle at the shop before 9 a.m. on Christmas Day in connection with the trade or business carried on in the shop without the consent of the local authority for the area in which the shop is situated, granted in accordance with section 2 of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004, and in accordance with any conditions subject to which that consent was granted
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2 of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004.

english.notes:
(i) Section 1(5) of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004 and Schedule 1 to the Sunday Trading Act 1994 define a large shop as a shop which has a relevant floor area exceeding 280 square metres and the relevant floor area as the internal floor area of so much of the shop as consists of or is comprised in a building, but excluding any part of the shop which, throughout the period of seven days ending with the Christmas Day in question, is used neither for the serving of customers in connection with the sale of goods nor for the display of goods.
(ii) Section 1(5) of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004 and Schedule 1 to the Sunday Trading Act 1994 define shop as any premises where there is carried on a trade or business consisting wholly or mainly of the sale of goods.
(iii) Section 2(4) of the Act provides that loading control area means any area designated by a local authority as a loading control area in accordance with section 2 of the Sunday Trading Act 1994.
